inclusion_criteria: HER2-positive advanced or metastatic breast cancer
Documented disease progression while receiving trastuzumab deruxtecan (T-DXd) in the metastatic setting
Ability to undergo baseline tumor biopsy
Ability to provide blood samples at pre-specified time points
Ability to undergo baseline FDG-PET/CT and 89Zr-trastuzumab PET/CT (HER2-PET/CT)
Willingness to receive study treatment as assigned (T-DM1 if HER2-PET/CT positive or physician's choice if HER2-PET/CT negative)
Ability to comply with scheduled FDG-PET/CT assessments (before cycle 2 and cycle 4 of T-DM1, and every 3 months for responders)
ECOG performance status ≤ 1

Histologically or cytologically confirmed progressive advanced/metastatic HER2-positive breast carcinoma as per the updated American Society of Clinical Oncology (ASCO) – College of American Pathologists (CAP) guidelines according to local testing; HER2 status may be determined in the primary breast cancer tumour or, when not available, in a metastatic lesion
Multifocal unilateral or bilateral breast adenocarcinoma tumours are allowed if all tested HER2-positive according to local testing

Prior treatment with taxane, trastuzumab and pertuzumab (early or advanced setting) and T-DXd (metastatic setting); must have received T-DXd as the last systemic metastatic treatment line before inclusion and have disease progression on this drug

Prior therapy with tucatinib, trastuzumab, and capecitabine in the advanced setting is permissible provided that T-DXd serves as the last systemic metastatic treatment line before inclusion and the patient presented disease progression on this drug
Life expectancy ≥ 6 months
At screening FDG-PET, at least two target lesions must have an anatomic transaxial diameter ≥ 1.5 cm
At screening FDG-PET, at least two target lesions must be metabolically assessable with a maximum standard uptake value corrected for lean
Anatomically transaxial diameter of lesion ≤ 1.5 cm.
Lesion metabolically assessable with SUVmax ≤ 1.5 × SUVmean + 2 SD of liver measured in a 3‑cm‑diameter VOI in normal liver parenchyma.
For suspected liver metastasis, lesion SUVmax ≤ 2 × SUVmean + 3 SD of blood pool measured in a 1‑cm‑diameter VOI within descending thoracic aorta.
Lesions must not have been pre‑treated with irradiation.
Absolute neutrophil count ≥ 1000/µL (or ≥1 × 10⁹/L).
Platelet count ≥ 100,000/µL (or ≥100 × 10⁹/L).
Hemoglobin ≥ 9 g/dL.
Serum creatinine ≤ 1.5 × ULN.
Estimated creatinine clearance ≥ 60 mL/min.
Total serum bilirubin ≤ 1.5 × ULN unless patient has documented Gilbert syndrome.
AST and ALT ≤ 2.5 × ULN.
Left ventricular ejection fraction ≥ 50 % on echocardiography or MUGA.
No history of left ventricular ejection fraction < 40 %.
No history of symptomatic heart failure.
No recent myocardial infarction.
Willingness to provide tumor tissue (mandatory biopsy) for translational research.
Willingness to provide blood samples for translational research.
Willingness to comply with the protocol for the duration of the study, including treatment and scheduled visits and examinations.
Signed informed consent form obtained prior to any study‑related procedure.
Affiliated to the French Social Security System (France only).
HER2‑positive metastatic breast cancer.
At least one prior line of systemic therapy for advanced disease.

HER2 PET/CT classification as positive (the entire or majority of the tumour load shows significant tracer uptake) or negative (the dominant part or all of the tumour load lacks significant tracer uptake).
exclusion_criteria: Prior exposure to T‑DM1 for treatment of metastatic breast cancer.
Prior exposure to T‑DM1 for early breast cancer with relapse while on treatment or within 12 months of finishing T‑DM1.
Brain metastasis as sole metastasis.
Symptomatic brain metastasis.
Brain metastasis requiring therapy to control symptoms.
History of interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis (grade 3 or 4) during prior treatment with T‑DXd.
Significant symptoms (Grade ≥ 2) relating to left‑ventricular dysfunction, cardiac arrhythmia, or cardiac ischemia while or since receiving preoperative therapy.
Uncontrolled hypertension (systolic > 180 mmHg or diastolic > 100 mmHg).
Inadequately controlled angina.
Serious cardiac arrhythmia not controlled by adequate medication.
Severe conduction abnormality.
Clinically significant valvular disease.
Screening LVEF < 50 % by either echocardiography or MUGA.
History of NCI CTCAE Grade ≥ 3 symptomatic congestive heart failure.
History of NYHA Class ≥ II.
History of a decrease in LVEF to < 40 % or symptomatic CHF with prior trastuzumab treatment.
Myocardial infarction within 12 months prior to randomization.
Requirement for continuous oxygen therapy.
Known prior severe hypersensitivity to the investigational product or any of its components, including severe hypersensitivity reactions to trastuzumab or excipients.
Contra‑indication for treatment with T‑DM1.
Progression within the first 6 months of T‑DXd therapy after enrollment of 7 rapid progressors (capped at 10% of total enrollment).
After the first 7 "rapid progressors" included, progression within the first 6 months of T-DXd therapy will be considered as an exclusion criterion.
Any known liver disease, including known carriers of hepatitis B virus, hepatitis C, autoimmune hepatic disorders and sclerosing cholangitis.
Concurrent, serious, uncontrolled infections or known infection with HIV.
Prior history of other invasive cancer in the past 5 years except basal or squamous cell carcinoma of skin that has been definitively treated.
Pregnant and/or lactating women, or intending to become pregnant during the study.
Serum pregnancy test (for subjects of childbearing potential) positive within 15 days prior to enrolment.

Women of childbearing potential refusing to use one highly effective method of contraception from ICF signature, during the course of the study and at least 7 months after the last administration of T-DM1.
Men with childbearing potential partner refusing to use condom during the course of this study and for at least 7 months after the last administration of T-DM1.

Subject with a significant medical, neuro‑psychiatric, or surgical condition, currently uncontrolled by treatment, which, in the principal investigator's opinion, may interfere with completion of the study.

Exclusion criterion applicable to FRANCE only: vulnerable persons according to the article L.1121‑6 of the Public Health Code, adults who are the subject of a measure of legal protection or unable to express their consent according to article L.1121‑8 of the Public Health Code.
